notes.title: November 18, 2024 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch v0.3.0.202411181130 is live! [/h1]

[h2]Quality of life changes include:[/h2]

[list]
[*] New Home Screen!
[*] Buffs and Debuffs play animations when they are activated (in most cases)
[*] Buffs and Debuffs got their own color scheme (in most cases)
[*] Buffs and Debuffs are hidden with a delay at the end of the combat
[*] Curios play animations when they are activated (in most cases)
[*] Starbinding has a new Icon that represents it’s level (1, 2 or 3 stars)
[*] Starbinding level is now displayed on the map as well
[*] Starbinding message is displayed when it levels up
[*] UI Scaling on larger screens is improved
[/list]

[h2]Balance fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Boss: Baron replaced with Baroness!!!
[*] Inner Fury: Depletes after being played
[*] Tower Shield: Guard value increased to 15/22(+)
[*] Flailing Hand: Damage value reduced to 6/9(+)
[*] Warm Up: Energy cost reduced from 2 to 1
[*] Lose Control: Sharp pain is shuffled in Discard instead of Draw pile
[*] Lightning Biome: 1 Brittle is applied instead of 1 Defenseless
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Prevented player from having negative gold
[*] Environment shader loading fixed
[*] Neutral cards in rewards no longer include cards that can only be obtained in events
[*] Multiple card leveling issues resolved
[*] Defenseless: Ticks properly when applied to player
[*] Rage: Reduced card cost is properly applied
[*] Thorns: Damage return is stopped after the character is killed (for multi iteration attacks)
[*] Game Event OnFloorClimed is fired properly
[*] Abandon Run is possible from Runestone Plane and Starbinding screen
[*] Card piles text is corrected
[*] Multiple Buff / Debuff fixes
[*] Multiple descriptions are updated
[/list]

notes.title: November 8, 2024 Update
notes.notes:
[b]Quality of life changes include[/b]:

[list]
[*] [b]Detailed [/b][b]Tags [/b]([b]Keyword[/b]) system. Keywords that appear in card, curio and other descriptions are now explained in a popup when you hover an item.
[*] [b]Seth, the Stargazer[/b] introduced! Seth is a mysterious figure that will lead you on your journey, and also give hints about the lore of Drakefall.
[*] [b]Runestone plane[/b] encounter provides you with more information, positive and negative effects are color coded.
[*] [b]Runestone plane[/b] scene improvements.
[*] [b]Starbinding [/b]explained. Starbinding screen now features a little bit of lore information. Also, the explanation of how the reward claiming works is added.
[*] [b]Starbinding [/b]screen visual improvements.
[*] Hovering [b]enemy intents[/b] now gives you detailed information about what the enemy intends to do!
[*] Most buffs and debuffs now have a new [b]color scheme[/b] instead of all being the same color.
[*] [b]Popups [/b]are [b]no longer transparent[/b] (for improved readability)
[*] Picking up [b]Curios [/b]now activates [b]visual feedback[/b]
[*] [b]Reward screen[/b] includes explanation that you need to click to claim each reward
[/list]

[b]Balance fixes[/b]:

[list]
[*] [b]Fire biome Immolate[/b] debuff reduced from 4 to 3
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]:

[list]
[*] [b]Lightning biome[/b] rendering issue fixed 
[*] [b]Salamander [/b]and [b]Sylph [/b]Blessing card type and availability is now properly set
[*] Several [b]stability [/b]issues resolved
[/list]
